scope: Presentation and learning UX on the existing bilingual GitHub Pages site.
findings: The existing paper palette and editorial illustrations provide a coherent foundation.
Search was separated from the top of the catalogue by a long beginner introduction.
Subject browsing and clear course actions were missing.
Nutrition was an unclassified section outside the searchable card inventory.
Legacy position labels competed with the course toolbar.
A narrow Theosophy overview illustration extended beyond the viewport.
changes: Original calligraphic display typography for h1–h3, with readable body and interface text.
Illustrated cards with clearer actions, subject filters and course counts where supported by the course adapter.
Compact, expandable beginner guidance above course search.
Nutrition joins the searchable catalogue and its language label is corrected.
Optional larger reading text and focus mode with keyboard exit.
Focus and size controls degrade safely when storage is blocked; only explicit text-size choices use sessionStorage.
Existing authored reading documents, saved-note namespaces and progress functions retained.

font.delivery: Self-hosted Latin WOFF2, 15 KB regular and 12 KB bold; Portuguese glyphs verified.
font.attribution: A renamed calligraphic derivative chosen for a Waldorf-inspired visual feel; not claimed as an original Steiner or official institutional typeface.

limits: Representative browser checks do not constitute a learner usability study.
The 13 pre-existing repository validation failures remain; their first failures match the previous revision.
Browser checks use the local generated site with a GitHub Pages path prefix.
